description: Headquarters: Remote - UK Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase . As a Derivative Sales Analyst on the Institutional team, you'll own and grow relationships with Coinbase's top VIP derivatives traders, driving volume across futures, options, and perpetuals. You'll source new high-value traders from competitor venues, re-engage dormant accounts, and bring structured market and client insights back to Product, Risk, and Marketing to shape Coinbase Advanced trading offerings. What you'll do: • Own and grow relationships with top VIP derivatives traders on Coinbase, driving increased trading volume, deepening engagement, and expanding adoption of advanced trading products. • Source and convert new high-value derivatives traders from competitor venues through targeted outbound campaigns, market positioning, and relationship-building. • Monitor derivatives market structure, client flows, and competitor offerings to identify upsell opportunities, inform pricing and product feedback, and deliver structured insights to Product, Risk, and Marketing. • Maintain an accurate pipeline and forecast for your book, reporting on key KPIs (volume, active traders, winbacks, competitor migration) and documenting client interactions through CRM tooling. • Reactivate previously dormant top traders using data-driven tools and bespoke incentives to restore sustained volume. • Build and refine AI-powered workflows for pipeline prioritization, client segmentation, and outreach personalization to scale coverage across your book. Everything we create is designed to make designers' lives easier, and our marketing reflects that. We focus on education, practical advice, and helping designers succeed—not pushy sales tactics. Apply for the job: Love writing clear, helpful content and keeping marketing projects moving? Join DesignFiles as a remote Content Marketing Coordinator. title: Fast Track Operations Specialist 2
Project Operations Specialist
description: About Toptal Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce . We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold. Job Summary As a Project Operations Specialist, you will be a key member of the Talent Screening team and the operational partner who ensures screening work moves seamlessly from request to execution. You will coordinate sourcing requests, maintain screening readiness, monitor operational performance, support cross-service talent movement, and help launch new screening initiatives. In this role, you will own the day-to-day execution of screening operations by coordinating stakeholders, tracking dependencies, maintaining accurate documentation, identifying risks early, and ensuring work is completed on time. You will work closely with the Screening Operations Manager, Sourcing teams, Screeners, Analytics, Product, and other cross-functional partners. This is an individual contributor role with meaningful end-to-end ownership. We are looking for someone who is highly organized, analytical, proactive, and excels at bringing clarity and structure to complex operational workflows. This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English. Responsibilities: The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills. • Coordinate sourcing requests from intake through launch, ensuring all required information is complete and requests meet the 24-hour preparation standard. • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to clarify requirements, track dependencies, resolve blockers, and ensure timely execution. • Maintain accurate operational trackers, documentation, decision logs, and process guidance. • Monitor screening readiness, capacity, funnel performance, and operational metrics, identifying risks and recommending improvements. • Escalate operational risks with clear context and recommended actions. • Support talent movement across services and acquired-company onboarding by coordinating screening requirements and stakeholder handoffs. • Coordinate screening path updates across operations, content, systems, and screeners to ensure successful implementation. • Perform data quality checks, investigate discrepancies, and maintain reliable operational reporting. • Serve as a primary operational point of contact for screening-related requests, ensuring clear ownership and follow-through. • Contribute to process improvements, documentation, and new screening initiatives that improve efficiency and scalability. In the first week, expect to: • Complete onboarding and become familiar with the Talent Screening team, systems, tools, and operational workflows. • Meet key stakeholders and gain an understanding of screening operations and business priorities. • Shadow sourcing request preparation, screening readiness reviews, and cross-functional processes. In the first month, expect to: • Build a solid understanding of the end-to-end screening process and operational workflows. • Begin managing sourcing requests and operational follow-ups with guidance from the Screening Operations Manager. • Develop effective working relationships with cross-functional partners. In the first three months, expect to: • Independently manage sourcing requests while maintaining the 24-hour preparation standard. • Monitor screening readiness, capacity, and operational health, proactively identifying risks and opportunities. • Recommend and implement improvements to workflows, documentation, or operational processes. In the first six months, expect to: • Own operational execution across your assigned scope with minimal oversight. • Support the launch and scaling of new screening initiatives and operational improvements, while exercising discretion and independent judgment. • Drive efficiencies by improving processes, documentation, and operational reporting. In the first year, expect to: • Become a trusted operational partner across the Talent Screening organization. • Help build scalable, transparent operational processes that support business growth. • Influence operational improvements through data-driven insights and cross-functional collaboration. • Be recognized for consistently delivering operational excellence, strong ownership, and reliable execution. Qualifications and Job Requirements: • Bachelor’s Degree is required. • 2-4+ years of experience in operations, talent operations, project coordination, program management, or a similar cross-functional environment. • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and stakeholders while maintaining strong attention to detail. • Strong analytical skills with experience using operational data to identify trends, solve problems, and improve processes. • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly communicate priorities, risks, and recommendations. • Advanced proficiency with spreadsheets and operational tracking tools; experience with dashboards, workflow automation, or low-code/no-code tools is a plus. • Strong process orientation with a continuous improvement mindset. • High level of ownership, accountability, and follow-through. • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment with changing priorities. • Experience supporting talent screening, marketplace operations, or technology-enabled operations is preferred. • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

title: Sales Intern (Italian)
description:
👷🏻‍♀️ What we do 👷🏻‍♀️

At Emidat, we are building the first climate-native product management system for building material manufacturers. We aim to decarbonise building materials, making up 11% of global GHG emissions. We collect data from physical production processes, generate a digital product passport with verified environmental data and make it usable along the value chain. In short: One solution to assess, design, buy, sell and manage products - with environmental impact at the core.

With this, we are building the digital infrastructure to make it faster, easier, and more sustainable to build the world around us.

Find out more about us, the team and our values here.

What you will work on

Your mission

Accelerate Emidat’s growth by acquiring new leads, being Emidat’s first face to the customer and building our predictable, repeatable revenue engine. Work closely with the Sales Development Rep and Account Executive on the go-to-market plan for the country.

As our Sales Intern (Italian), you will be driving our revenue pipeline focussing on the Italian market. In this role, you are the first face and voice to our customer, so this role is perfect if you love being around people and have a talent for convincing, understanding and solving their problems.

At Emidat, we see top-of-funnel as equally important if not more so than closing deals. Without leads, there is no revenue. We are searching for a hungry sales person, who is not scared of approaching people actively and being the face of Emidat. Your customers are manufacturers, so you shouldn’t be shy and bring a curiosity for material manufacturing and construction (note: we think visiting steel, cement and glass plants is the coolest thing in the world next to customers holding their product into the Teams call to show us how it’s done).

Your challenge:

Joining our sales development team involves:

  • Customer Pipeline Development: Build and nurture our customer pipeline, from initial prospecting to booking a demo.

  • Go-to-Market Strategy: Develop and fine-tune our go-to-market strategy, ensuring alignment with our company objectives.

  • Revenue Engine: Build and improve our repeatable and predictable revenue engine.

  • Team Building: Play a key role in building and growing the sales team leading us to 3mn ARR.

Your first 3 months at Emidat (sample)

Any Emidavinci starts with a detailed 3-month OKR sheet, which helps to build clarity and accountability from day 1. This is only a high-level overview how this can look like as a Sales Development Executive, but you will find many of the points on your 3-month list in your first week again.

1. Deeply understand our customer and market

  • Customer Mastery: Call customers, attend conferences and deeply understand our target customers.

  • Discovery Calls: Conduct your first discovery calls and schedule at least 20 demos

  • Demo Shadowing: Shadow at least 10 demos to learn how we close deals.

2. Plan and conduct your own outbound campaigns

  • Campaign Ownership: Design your own outbound campaign (incl. list, workflows and sequences). Plan and own 3 campaigns in total

  • RevOps: Analyze and improve email open/reply rates (target: 25%+ open rate, 5%+ reply rate)

  • Outbound prospecting: Execute on the campaigns (e.g. follow-up with calls, send emails/LinkedIn requests)

3. Get to know and improve our revenue engine design

  • CRM / RevOps Mastery: Become comfortable with our CRM and sales material

  • Sales Playbook & Objection Handling: Read through our sales playbook, as well as our objection- and competitor handling, start using it and suggest improvements

  • Market understanding: Understand ICP, persona and JTBD framework; start using it to include your insights

What you will bring to this role

Minimum Requirements

  • Language: Fluent in Italian (C2/Native). Proficiency (B2+) in English.

  • Client Experience: Some level of experience working with clients / customers, or a real passion for being in a customer facing position.

  • Strong Communication Skills: Effective communication skills, both verbal and written, to communicate with customers and collaborate with team members.

  • Organisational Skills: Ability to manage tasks and responsibilities effectively.

Nice to have’s

  • Language: Proficiency in another European Language (German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Turkish).

  • Sales Experience: Prior experience in business development, growth or sales.

  • Startup: Experience in a startup or scaleup.

How we support you

Your team lead will be

  • Janos Grundling (Team Lead, Sales Development)

You will work with

  • Federico (Account Executive)

  • Elise (Sales Development)

  • Joey (Sales Development)

  • Isabel (Team Lead, Go-to-Market)

Your mentors will be

  • Sales: Mathias Salomon (built up GTM at Forto and Parloa)

  • Sales: Christoph Deckert (built up GTM at Personio)

  • GTM / Sales: Julius Köhler (Co-Founder, Sennder; Emidat Board)

  • Sales: Lisa Gradow (Co-Founder & CEO at Fides, Sequoia Arc ‘22, prev. Co-Founder and CPO at Usercentrics)

Meet the rest of the team HERE.

See our full benefits HERE, including:

  • 💸 Attractive compensation package incl commission

  • 🏖️ 25 days of vacation days per year (pro rata)

  • 📚 €500 Learning Budget

 

Admin:

  • Start date: as soon as possible

  • Role type: Intern. Minimum 4 months, start ASAP.

  • Location: Munich, Germany

  • Office Requirement: Office based

  • Travel Required? Some travel may be required to attend relevant industry events

  • Visa / Relocation: Preference will be given to candidates already based in Munich and that do not require visa sponsorship. However, we are open to candidates who may need relocation or a visa.

title: Better Proposals: Junior SEO Specialist
description: Headquarters: Brighton, UK URL: https://betterproposals.io/ Are you “the one”? We're looking for a Junior SEO Specialist to join our growth team. You’ll work directly with the Growth Manager and help with everything SEO related, from keyword research and internal linking to technical SEO, content planning and link building. This is a junior role, but not a trainee position. You should already understand the basics, know your way around the usual SEO tools and be ready to work on a real website. You will not be expected to know everything. You will be expected to learn as much as possible and figure things out. What does the job look like? The role covers most areas of SEO, including: • Researching keywords and identifying new opportunities • Reviewing existing pages and recommending improvements • Finding and implementing internal linking opportunities • Creating content briefs and proposing new pages • Monitoring rankings, traffic and organic conversions • Using Google Search Console to investigate performance and indexing • Crawling the website with Screaming Frog • Using Ahrefs for keyword, competitor, content and backlink research • Finding and qualifying link building prospects • Running outreach campaigns and following up with contacts • Tracking new links and reporting on campaign performance • Identifying common technical SEO issues • Creating and checking structured data • Improving page titles, descriptions, headings and on-page content • Helping us track GEO, AIO and AI search visibility You will not do every one of these things every day, and you will not be the only one on the team. Don’t have experience with all of these? Don’t worry. Some weeks will be more focused on content. Others might involve technical checks, outreach or improving pages that are already performing well. What we’re looking for You should already understand: • The basics of technical, on-page and off-page SEO • How to do keyword research • How to assess search intent • How internal linking works • The basics of link building and outreach • How to use Google Search Console • How to use the main reports in Ahrefs • How to crawl and inspect a website with Screaming Frog • What schema and structured data are • How to use AI tools to work faster without trusting everything they produce You do not need to be an expert in every area. We are looking for someone who understands the fundamentals, can follow a process and is willing to figure stuff out when they don’t immediately understand them. You should also be comfortable working independently. You will get direction and feedback and someone will always be there for you. But we are not interested in micro management. Nice to have It would be useful if you have experience with any of the following: • SaaS SEO • WordPress or another CMS • Basic HTML • Writing content briefs • Link building outreach • SEO reporting and analytics • GEO, AIO or optimisation for AI search tools Experience with GEO or AIO is welcome, but not required. Nobody has ten years of GEO experience. A genuine interest in learning about it is enough. Benefits • Salary dependent on experience and what you can bring to the role. We use Glassdoor as a guide for your location and pay above average. • Remote work in a global company, with a friendly and hardworking team • Opportunity to grow within the company, and earn promotions and pay rises • No work on your birthday • 3 weeks paid holiday + 1 week for every year (capped at 6 weeks) • Choose 8 national holidays that make sense to your country. • Annual bonus based on personal performance Our AI policy We don’t hate AI, but we NEVER use AI tools to produce customer facing content. Our customer support is not AI based, you always have a live person to talk to. Our articles are not AI written slop, but real opinions and expertise of real people. We want it to stay that way. Using AI tools for keyword research, data analytics and process improvements is cool. Posting what ChatGPT spits out and passing it as a blog article is a fireable offence! Next steps Assuming everything goes well, here’s how our hiring process goes: • You apply • We have an initial interview • We will have a 2nd interview • In special cases we might have a quick 3rd call to clarify a few things, but mostly not. • We offer you the job • You’re expected to accept it within 1 business day. Application deadline: Friday 28th August 2026 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/better-proposals-junior-seo-specialist
